    - #101 has 2 changed lines.
    - #97 has 4.
    - #112 has 6.
13. **Decision: 3 matches on Claude Code**, which is the "2+ Claude Code" row.

    - The discovered list goes in the visible text of the reply carrying that read (**Reply 1**, with the menu-layout read attached).
